subject.title: [Bug]: Web UI chat images display too large

question: Should maintainers adopt, replace, or reject the open fork PR that changes sidebar markdown images from `100%`/420px to the main chat `min(100%, 420px)`/320px sizing?
rationale: The issue has a narrow open closing PR and current-main source evidence for the remaining gap, but adoption may require maintainer judgment because the fork PR is not maintainer-modifiable and still needs live UI proof.

options.title: Adopt or Replace the Fix
options.body: Use the linked PR as source work, or open a maintainer replacement with the same narrow sidebar CSS change and live Web UI proof.

options.title: Keep Open for More Repro
options.body: Leave the issue open until someone captures a live extended-session reproduction showing exactly where the image growth occurs.

options.title: Reject the Sidebar Parity Change
options.body: Close the issue only if maintainers decide sidebar markdown is intentionally allowed to use the wider sizing.

recommendation.title: Adopt or Replace the Fix
recommendation.body: Use the linked PR as source work, or open a maintainer replacement with the same narrow sidebar CSS change and live Web UI proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history ties this handle to the current chat/sidebar/text CSS surface and nearby Web UI maintenance.
